name: Deep Wilderness Dungeon
accessNote: Wilderness hill giants for Krystilia: the Deep Wilderness Dungeon holds 6 spawns (~level 50 Wilderness), with further F2P Wilderness spawns at the Boneyard Hunter area and the Lava Maze. Kills count for Krystilia only in the Wilderness. The Slayer task/Hill giants table (pageid 298054) lists the Deep Wilderness Dungeon as cannonable and safespottable (single-combat).
